name: criss-telemetry-portal
description: Real-time rover telemetry portal (CRISS Robotics recruitment task)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared
